title: A lane start is refused while a PR its step starts after is unmerged
why: Coordinator's own mistake, 12:18 CST Nov 9: it started 8 lanes whose steps say "starts after #N" while #N was an open draft; the lanes went idle and back to todo (real-reftable-fixture, retire-use-hooks-home, frozen-crash-followups, branch-force-other-worktree, parallel-wrapper-flags, rm-after-cd-one-walk, push-refs-drop-redirects). Harm: lanes started on a base that is not on main sit idle or build on the wrong base.
note: Fix: a check in the lane-start path or the brief guard reads the step's "starts after" and "Merge after" PRs and refuses a lane start while any of them is unmerged. Red case first: a brief for a step whose start PR is open. Related: step lane-start-checks-roadmap (the same lane-start path). Incident (13:59 CST Nov 9): triage filed shell-could-write-linear from #1971's round 3 with no starts-after line, and the code it names exists only in that unmerged PR. A step filed from an unmerged PR's review round carries that PR as starts-after.
